cases.title: A proposal brief becomes a Word document in the template's five sections

inputs.brief: Proposal to move the Harbor archive from the cloud bucket to local storage at the Dubai office. Reader: the operations director, Laura Grant. Today the archive costs $1,900 a month in storage fees. The move needs 2 engineers for 6 weeks and a one-off hardware cost of $42,000. It would start on 2 November 2026 and finish by 12 December 2026. Risk: a restore test is needed before the old bucket is deleted. Ask: approve the budget by 15 October.

inputs.brief: Tell our landlord we want to renew the lease on Unit 4, 22 Harbour Street for another two years from 1 January 2027. We accept the proposed rent of AED 96,000 a year. Ask them to send the renewal contract by 30 November 2026.
